text:
You started your day with standup, continuing the rhythm you’ve built at this time of week. At 11:00 AM, we had your roadmap sync, which went better than you expected and wrapped up in about twenty minutes. Later, I added a note to your roadmap regarding capacity numbers from Dev for that sync.

For your personal admin, I set a reminder for tomorrow morning at 9:00 AM to call the physio clinic to book your next appointment, since I couldn't book it directly myself. I also added a tentative placeholder in your calendar for the week after next. You asked about opening hours at the Dickson post office; I searched but couldn't find a reliable listing for that branch specifically, so you planned to check on the way instead. I set a reminder for 4:45 PM today to pick up your parcel from there.

For lunch, I suggested halloumi and capsicum wraps using what you had in the fridge, pan-fried with some yoghurt or hummus inside. Canberra was partly cloudy today with a high of 24°C, but you were glad the sun came out after lunch so you could get a coffee outside.
